source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of erythroblastosis foetalis; the book's problem is a self-check with a drawn Punnett square (PDF 95-96).

blocks.text: Erythroblastosis foetalis janeen (foetus) ya naumolood (new-born) bachche ki haemolytic bimari hai, yaani aisi bimari jis mein RBCs toot jate hain. Yeh Rh-negative hamla (pregnant) maa aur Rh-positive janeen ke darmiyan Rh incompatibility (Rh ka na milna) se hoti hai.

Yeh tab hoti hai jab Rh-negative maa (dd) ke pait mein Rh-positive bachcha (DD ya Dd) ho. Janeen ka kuch khoon maa ke khoon mein ja sakta hai. Janeen ke Rh-antigens ka saamna hone par maa anti-Rh antibodies banati hai. Yeh antibodies placenta paar kar ke janeen ke khoon mein pahunch jati hain aur wahan janeen ke RBCs ko tabah karti hain. Is se janeen mein haemolytic anaemia (RBCs toot jane se khoon ki kami) aur doosri sangeen pecheedgiyan hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: placenta ka kata hua hissa. Umbilical cord chorion se judti hai; janeen ki nalyon wale shakhdar villi maa ke khoon ke hauz (maternal blood pool) mein latakte hain jise maternal arteries aur veins khoon deti hain; hauz ka chhota chaukor neeche bara dikhaya gaya hai. Neeche baen: janeen ke red cells villus se nikal kar maa ke khoon mein jate hain jahan us ke B cells anti-Rh antibodies banate hain. Neeche daen: maa ki anti-Rh antibodies villi aur janeen ke khoon mein dakhil hoti hain.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Umbilical cord, Chorion, Placenta, Maternal arteries & veins, Maternal blood pool, Foetal RBCs enter into mother's blood, Mother's B cells produce anti-Rh antibodies, Maternal anti-Rh antibodies enter into foetal blood.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen taraf placenta hai jahan janeen ke villi maa ke khoon ke hauz (blood pool) mein hote hain. Beech ki tasveer: janeen ke RBCs maa ke khoon mein jate hain aur maa ke B cells anti-Rh antibodies banate hain. Daen tasveer: maa ki anti-Rh antibodies wapas janeen ke khoon mein ja kar us ke RBCs tabah karti hain.

Shadeed soorat mein janeen ke RBCs ki tabahi se isqat (miscarriage) ya murda paidaish (stillbirth) ho sakti hai. Agar janeen bach jaye to us ka jigar (liver) aur tilli (spleen) zyada RBCs banane ki koshish mein bare ho jate hain. RBCs tootne se bilirubin banta hai jo jama ho kar yarqan (jaundice: peeli jild aur aankhein) karta hai. Zyada bilirubin dimagh ke cells ko bhi nuqsan de sakta hai. Bach jane wale bachche ka khoon aise Rh-negative khoon se badal diya jata hai jis mein anti-Rh antibodies na hon.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Kabhi kabhi ABO incompatibility bachche ko Rh incompatibility se bacha leti hai. Agar O-negative maa ke pait mein A-positive ya B-positive bachcha ho to maa ke khoon mein aane wale janeen ke RBCs ko maa ki pehle se maujood anti-A ya anti-B antibodies jaldi tabah kar deti hain, is se pehle ke maa anti-Rh antibodies bana sake.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Jab Rh-incompatibility ka khatra ho to maa ko hamal ke shuru mein aur paidaish ke foran baad Rh-antiserum (anti-Rh antibodies wala serum) ka injection diya jata hai. Yeh maa ke khoon mein pahunche bachche ke RBCs ko is se pehle tabah kar deta hai ke maa ka mudafiati nizam (immune system) un ke khilaf hassas (sensitized) ho.

blocks.prompt: Aik Rh-negative aurat ki shadi aise Rh-positive mard se hui jis ka baap Rh-negative tha. Family ke har fard ke mumkina genotypes kya hain? Cross ka Punnett square bana kar batayein ke bachche ke erythroblastosis foetalis se mutasir hone ka imkaan kya hai.
blocks.explanation: Aurat Rh-negative hai: dd. Mard Rh-positive hai aur us ke baap (dd) ne use d diya, is liye mard Dd hai. Mard ka baap dd, aur us ki maa Rh-positive honi chahiye (DD ya Dd), kyunke mard ko D usi se mila. Dd × dd ka Punnett square: 1/2 Dd (Rh-positive) aur 1/2 dd (Rh-negative). Is liye har bachche ke Rh-positive hone, yaani khatre mein hone, ka imkaan 1/2 hai. Asal bimari tab hoti hai jab maa pehle se anti-Rh antibodies bana chuki ho (aam taur par pehle Rh-positive hamal ke baad), aur Rh-antiserum ke injection se ise roka ja sakta hai.

answer_figure.alt: Punnett square: mard Rh-positive (Dd) ke gametes D aur d baen taraf, aurat Rh-negative (dd) ke gametes d aur d oopar. Oopar ki qatar: Dd, Dd (Rh-positive); neeche ki qatar: dd, dd (Rh-negative). Neeche: Dd 1/2 khatre mein, dd 1/2 khatre mein nahi.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram (pehle khud banayein, phir milayein): Rh-positive mard (Dd) × Rh-negative aurat (dd) ka Punnett square
answer_figure.long_description: Oopar 'Man: Rh-positive (Dd) × Woman: Rh-negative (dd)'. Grid ke oopar aurat ke gametes d, d aur baen taraf mard ke gametes D, d. Pehli qatar: Dd (Rh-positive), Dd (Rh-positive), gulabi rang mein. Doosri qatar: dd (Rh-negative), dd (Rh-negative), surmai rang mein. Neeche likha hai: Dd (Rh-positive) = 1/2, aisa bachcha khatre mein hai; dd (Rh-negative) = 1/2, khatre mein nahi.

items: Rh-negative maa (dd) + Rh-positive janeen: maa ki anti-Rh antibodies janeen ke RBCs tabah karti hain.
Asraat: anaemia, bara jigar aur tilli, yarqan (bilirubin), dimagh ko nuqsan, isqat ya murda paidaish.
Bachao: hamal ke shuru aur paidaish ke foran baad Rh-antiserum; ABO incompatibility bhi kabhi bacha leti hai.
